answer.book: Printed Latin book of 1691 (Amsterdam, Eickenberg) by Tobias Andreae, containing front matter (reader's note, preface, dedication to Dietz) followed by two numbered Exercitationes physicæ on the power of evil angels over bodies, each divided into chapters, ending with a closing doxology and a short appended quotation from Wittichius.
